scenario: One series declaration per (slot path, file) per LSER.10.15. Two declarations targeting the same slot path within one file are a compile error. Authors who want both running stats and raw samples on the same logical concept either combine observations into one declaration or split into two slots. Pin: two `series Sensor.state:` decls in the same file reject with DS_VALIDATE_SERIES_DUPLICATE_DECL.
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float mutable

series Sensor.state:
    mean sliding 10_s

series Sensor.state:
    count sliding 5_s
